subject: Compressing MAP + order form gating — timeline & DPA redlines
messages:
From: Ben Sutherland <ben.sutherland@novothera.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novothera.com, sara.li@novothera.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timeline compression request + DPA redlines attached

Stephanie —

Thanks for the run-through last week. We have an internal ask to accelerate the MAP and try to land commercial paperwork before mid‑June (target close: 2026‑06‑15). Procurement is prepared to sign the order form quickly if legal and security gating are satisfied, but they need to see final DPA language and SOC2 evidence.

I attached our redlines to the DPA — there are a couple of data residency and subprocessors items that our legal team flagged. Can Redwood confirm (1) whether the DPA redlines are acceptable, (2) a feasible turnaround for revisions, and (3) whether we can run evaluation workloads in a short pilot before full order form signature?

Also: FYI — procurement goes into a short freeze for headcount/budget reviews 2026-06-01 through 2026-06-07; anything we can do to front-load the order review would help.

Appreciate it —
Ben Sutherland
Head of Procurement, NovoThera
Attachments: Novothera_DPA_redlines_v1.docx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Sutherland <ben.sutherland@novothera.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline compression request + DPA redlines attached

Ben — thanks for the clarity and the file. We can work the compressed timeline, but it will require parallel tracks:

- Legal: quick-turn DPA review and a narrow set of alternative phrasing for the residency/subprocessor bullets (we can get back in 48–72 hrs with proposed language).
- Security: provide SOC2 Type II report and KMS/HSM controls evidence today; start evidence handoff to your InfoSec immediately.
- Commercial: get a signed MSA/order form path where the order form can be staged and routed to procurement while legal finalizes a DPA addendum.

Proposal (short):
1) Today: Redwood sends SOC2 + control brief; legal (Karthik) to review and return redlines by Thu 5/27.
2) Fri 5/28: Draft MAP with milestone owner & acceptance criteria (evaluation plan + signoff checklist).
3) Mon 6/07: Target MSA+order form ready for procurement routing (we'll aim to avoid the 6/01–6/07 internal freeze impact by early routing).
4) Tue 6/15: Commercial signature close target (if DPA addendum is accepted).

I CC'd Karthik/Vanessa/Rachel/Kimberly to coordinate legal, customer success, and sales ops tasks. Vanessa — can you spin a MAP that ties evaluation milestones to order form deliverables and lists fallback options?

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben.sutherland@novothera.com
Cc: sara.li@novothera.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline compression request + DPA redlines attached

All — quick legal read-through. High-level: the residency and subprocessors asks are broader than our standard DPA. We can offer the following path to keep timeline tight:

- Option A (preferred for speed): sign MSA with Redwood's standard DPA + a one‑page customer addendum that narrows the residency clause (explicitly lists regions) and a subprocessors notification regime (90 days opt‑out window for major subprocessor changes).
- Option B (if NovoThera requires contract-level changes): full DPA amendment — 7–10 business days to finalize depending on negotiation cycles.

I attached a redlined version with Option A language that preserves most of your asks while keeping risk within acceptable bounds for Redwood. If Novo's legal accepts Option A in principle, we can get a signed addendum within 3–5 business days.

Attachments: Redwood_revised_dpa_redlines_v2.docx

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben.sutherland@novothera.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP draft + evaluation plan — NovoThera pilot (attached)

Ben / team —

Attached is a first draft MAP that ties the evaluation plan (30‑day pilot) to commercial milestones. Key callouts:

- Evaluation plan: 2-week technical discovery -> 30-day pilot with two acceptance prompts and latency/cost targets.
- Security gating: SOC2 + PKI/KMS evidence transfer (we've included a minimal evidence checklist).
- Order form gating: order form signs when both (a) pilot acceptance criteria met and (b) DPA addendum is executed or an exceptions letter is issued.

Fallbacks we included: a hosted pilot agreement (30 days, ephemeral data retention 7 days) that allows you to run evaluation workloads without the full DPA in place. That buys procurement time while legal finalizes language.

I've linked the MAP in Drive here: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/shared/NV-MAP-DRAFT-0602

Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_NOVOTHERA_0602.xlsx

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Li <sara.li@novothera.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: ben.sutherland@novothera.com, procurement@novothera.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + evaluation plan — NovoThera pilot (attached)

Thanks, Vanessa. MAP looks sensible and we can proceed with the evaluation plan as outlined. Two procurement notes that will affect routing:

1) Procurement has a governance freeze 2026‑06‑01 through 2026‑06‑07 (internal budget window). We'll still accept early routing but cannot route for signature inside that window. Please route order form to procurement by 2026‑05‑31 EOD if you want them to start triaging before the freeze.

2) NovoThera legal prefers Option A (one‑page addendum) to preserve schedule. We will need SOC2 Type II (latest report) and a short KMS/HSM controls statement to attach to the procurement packet.

One additional ask: if DPA addendum isn't finished by 6/15, can Redwood commit to a canary pilot (hosted only) with an agreed short-term data retention policy (7 days) and no long-term storage? That will let our engineers validate performance while legal finishes paperwork.

Sara Li
Senior Counsel, NovoThera
